items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: My wife and I were going to services that day.

ctx.x: And, uh, we got to see each other more often. But he was, he never worried about shaving. He never worried about a haircut. He never worried about a goddamn thing. He looked like a bum. But, uh, he had a very sick, sick wife while his wife finally died. And then he moved, then he moved over to Bay St. Louis, I think. Uh, he was responsible for me owning this. I told him to be on the lookout. I wanted one of these almoors. And, uh, he called me on Yom Kippa Day, Day of Atonement. I was going to let my help off in…
I said, you've got what you want. Thank you.
